review_regressions.recheck_command: Fresh python -c consumer reading independently constructed source transitions, with project-module origins asserted; disposable original crates.

source_view_measurement.measurement: Throwaway instrumentation of immutable source-view construction; no elapsed-time claim.

limitations: Diagnostic continuity is compiler-span/source differencing, not arbitrary Rust semantic causality.
Generated/external/unmappable diagnostic sources remain ambiguous when preexistence cannot be established.
A newly expanded lock diagnostic retains all raw primary and child spans; the entire diagnostic is reported introduced, not every await claimed new.
Candidate failure and required baseline failure remain checker_failure; a not-required baseline is not a passed check.
Trusted Cargo execution is not an OS sandbox; original-tree integrity is before/after evidence, not concurrent-write prevention.
